title: Hardware Procurement Catalogue: Order Types, Product Classes and Order Size Limits
content:
Every Hardware Procurement quote is issued in exactly one order type, chosen by the product class of the line being quoted. The six order types run from rank 1 to rank 6, and every one of them requires a signed quote before anything is ordered.

## Classification schedule

| Rank | Order type | Product classes quoted in it | Other entry condition | Minimum quote total (USD) | Most units per order |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Accessory & Peripheral Order | monitors, docks, keyboards and mice, headsets, cables, desktop UPS units | signed quote | 0.00 | 500 |
| 2 | Standard Endpoint Order | laptops, desktops, tablets | signed quote | 0.00 | 250 |
| 3 | Staged Endpoint Order | laptops, desktops | device management enrollment required; signed quote | 0.00 | 100 |
| 4 | Network Equipment Order | firewalls, switches, wireless access points | signed quote | 0.00 | 100 |
| 5 | Server & Storage Build Order | servers, storage arrays, NAS units | signed quote | 0.00 | 20 |
| 6 | Special-Order Equipment | non-stock items, custom-configured items | quote total of at least 2500.00; signed quote | 2500.00 | 50 |

## Reading the schedule

- A quote total must reach the order type's minimum quote total. Only Special-Order Equipment sets a floor above zero, at 2500.00 USD; a Special-Order quote of 2499.99 does not reach it, one of exactly 2500.00 does.
- The quantity on one order may not exceed the order type's most units per order. A Server & Storage Build Order may carry 20 units but not 21; a Standard Endpoint Order may carry up to 250.
- Laptops and desktops appear in two order types. The Staged Endpoint Order is the one whose units are enrolled in device management; the Standard Endpoint Order carries laptops, desktops and tablets without that requirement. Tablets are quoted only as a Standard Endpoint Order.
